notes: REF-BM-02: only title is fetched, and only via a manual 'Get title' button click, not automatically on save; no description or preview image are collected at all; favicon is a third-party lookup by domain, not collected from the page. REF-BM-03/04/07/12: no 'description' field exists in the schema or UI at all (only title + notes), so any description-related facet is missing. REF-BM-06: createBookmark always inserts a new row; no url-dedup/lookup logic exists anywhere. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain comma-separated text field with no autocomplete/suggestion UI. REF-BM-12: search is a simple SQL LIKE over title/url/notes only, no description, not true full-text. REF-BM-14/15/16: search has no query-syntax parser — no #tag tokens, no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses, no quoted-phrase handling; it's a single substring LIKE. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag in the schema or UI. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action UI/endpoints. REF-BM-22: list is hardcoded ORDER BY created_at DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: notes are rendered as plain text, not parsed/rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot (HTML/PDF) or Internet Archive capture logic anywhere. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive list/endpoint. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity or saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no import/export code (Netscape HTML or otherwise). REF-BM-32: no user-settings entity or UI (sort/page-size/font).
